mapper.select:
select , t1.nickname as buyer_nickname, t1.avatar as buyer_avatar, t2.nickname as seller_nickname, t2.avatar as seller_avatar,
from `order` o left join (select id, nickname, avatar from `user`) t1 on o.buyer_id = t1.id left join (select id, nickname, avatar from `user`) t2 on o.seller_id = t2.id left join order_item oi on o.id = oi.order_id where o.id in
#{id}
order by o.create_time desc
mapper.insert:
insert into `order` ( order_no, buyer_id, seller_id, total_amount, pay_amount, address_snapshot, remark, create_time, update_time) values
( #{order.orderNo}, #{order.buyerId}, #{order.sellerId}, #{order.totalAmount}, #{order.payAmount}, #{order.addressSnapshot}, #{order.remark}, #{order.createTime}, #{order.updateTime} )

insert into order_item ( order_id, product_id, product_title, product_cover, price, quantity, total_amount) values
( #{item.orderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productTitle}, #{item.productCover}, #{item.price}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.totalAmount} )
